Done — one execution, no failures.

**What the script does** (`out/T3/solution.py`):
- Loads all 114 tensors via the input index, in lexicographic key order.
- Casts to bfloat16 only names matching the anchored regex `^model\.layers\.\d+\.(self_attn\.(q|k|v|o)_proj|mlp\.(gate|up|down)_proj)\.weight$` — 112 matrices; `model.embed_tokens.weight` and `lm_head.weight` stay float32. Nothing is renamed or deleted.
- Runs the four required checks (112 bf16, layer-0 q_proj bf16, embed_tokens fp32, 114 total) plus shape/dtype checks, all before any write; every failure raises.
- Greedy contiguous packing at 256 MiB of tensor data, with a single oversized tensor allowed alone in its shard, then writes shards + `model.safetensors.index.json` with a full `weight_map`.

**Result:** 10 shards — `lm_head.weight` and `model.embed_tokens.weight` alone (412 MB each), then 8 shards of exactly two layers (14 tensors, 256 MiB) each; 114 tensors, 2,971,664,384 bytes total.

Report written to `out/T3/REPORT.md`.
